name: Singapore Institute of Management (SIM Global Education)
description: SIM Global Education is the degree arm of the Singapore Institute of Management, a private education institution in Clementi, Singapore. It teaches, in Singapore, degrees awarded by partner universities in the UK, Australia, the US and Canada.
whyIncluded: Singapore's largest private provider of overseas university degrees, and the main local alternative for Singaporeans who do not take up a place at an Autonomous University or who want a UK, Australian or US degree without leaving Singapore.

partners.name: University of London
partners.description: A federal public university in the UK whose degrees, with academic direction from member institutions such as LSE, Goldsmiths and UCL, are taught in Singapore by SIM Global Education.

partners.name: University at Buffalo (SUNY)
partners.description: The University at Buffalo is the largest public research university in the State University of New York system; SIM teaches its single-major, double-major and double-degree bachelor's programmes in Singapore.

partners.name: University of Birmingham
partners.description: A Russell Group research university in Birmingham, England, whose triple-accredited Birmingham Business School degrees are taught at SIM in Singapore.

partners.name: University of Wollongong
partners.description: Public research university in New South Wales, Australia; SIM teaches its computing, business and psychology degrees in Singapore.

partners.name: RMIT University
partners.description: Public university of technology, design and enterprise based in Melbourne, Australia; SIM teaches its business, communication, design, aviation and construction degrees in Singapore.

partners.name: University of Stirling
partners.description: The University of Stirling is a public research university in Stirling, Scotland, founded in 1967; SIM teaches its marketing, sport and digital media bachelor's degrees in Singapore.

partners.name: Cardiff University
partners.description: Russell Group research university in Cardiff, Wales; SIM teaches its computer science top-up degrees and master's programmes in Singapore.

partners.name: The University of Sydney
partners.description: The University of Sydney is Australia's first university, founded in 1850; SIM teaches its part-time nursing bachelor's degrees for registered nurses in Singapore.

partners.name: University of Alberta
partners.description: A leading public research university in Edmonton, Canada, whose Alberta School of Business degrees are taught at SIM in Singapore.

Load stated for SIM Diploma holders with transfer credits: 78 credits, so totals S$552.63 x 78 = S$43,105.14 (local) and S$577.70 x 78 = S$45,060.60 (international), as the page also states; duration in the fee table is 2 years (full-time over 4 semesters, 2 per year), annual = total / 2. Note the programme-duration line reads '2 January 2027 to December 2029', which conflicts with the 2-year figure. International Student Induction Fee S$588.60 (international tier only). A one-time Student Development Fee of S$730.30 is listed separately and not included. SIM application fee (S$109 local / S$545 international) and the University of Alberta application fee excluded. Page does not say fees are fixed. History: no Common Crawl captures of this URL in 2024-2025 crawls and the Wayback CDX returned none. SIM's University of Alberta partnership dates from late 2024: the SIM Alberta partner page is first captured on 2024-12-13 and, through April 2026, lists only the MBA (FastTrack) (first intake May 2025, 'Programme Fees (May 2025 onwards)' S$39,240 Singaporean/PR, S$41,202 international). The Bachelor of Commerce is newer still: its page (programme-listing/uofa_bachelor-of-commerce) first appears in Common Crawl on 2026-07-21 with fees for the '2027 intake onwards'. It is absent from all 2024-2025 indexes and the Wayback CDX, and the partner page did not list it before then. No 2024 or 2025 intake, so no rows.

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration
programmes.summary: Tuition at SIM for a one-year University of Alberta MBA, including GST; Singaporeans and PRs pay a lower rate. Fees are charged per credit, and a one-off student development fee is extra.
programmes.notes: Page: 'Programme Fees (2027 intake onwards)', 2 January 2027 to December 2027 (full-time over 2 semesters), so feeYear 2026. Per-credit fees incl. 9% GST: local S$994.08, international S$1,042.04; 45 credits required, so totals S$994.08 x 45 = S$44,733.60 (local) and S$1,042.04 x 45 = S$46,891.80 (international), as the page states; 1-year programme so annual = total. International Student Induction Fee S$588.60 (international tier only). A one-time Student Development Fee of S$730.30 is listed separately and not included. Application fees excluded. Page does not say fees are fixed. History: no Common Crawl or Wayback captures of this URL. Common Crawl has 2024-2025 captures of a different Alberta page, 'Master of Business Administration (Fast Track)' (slug master-of-business-administration-(fasttrack), May 2025 onwards: S$39,240 Singaporean/PR, S$41,202 international), but that was described as a flexible online-format programme, so it is not recorded as history for this MBA. SIM's University of Alberta partnership dates from late 2024: the SIM Alberta partner page is first captured on 2024-12-13 and, through April 2026, lists only the MBA (FastTrack) (first intake May 2025, 'Programme Fees (May 2025 onwards)' S$39,240 Singaporean/PR, S$41,202 international). This MBA page (programme-listing/uofa_master-of-business-administration, first captured 2026-07-21, '2027 intake onwards', still headed 'Master of Business Administration (Fast Track)' in one place) replaced the FastTrack page, which returns 404 by August 2026. The FastTrack figures are not used as history. Admission differed (a business bachelor's degree with B+ versus any recognised degree with GPA 3.0), as did the format (online-supported trimester modules over 1 to 2 years versus a 1-year blended programme of 45 credits), and the FastTrack page gives no credit count. Its only stated intake fee (May 2025) would also be feeYear 2024. The slug master-of-business-administration seen in 2024-2026 captures is the University of Birmingham MBA, not this programme. No 2024 or 2025 rows.
